metadata.description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — wallet connect plugin for AI agents. Open source. Connects a wallet (Google/email via Privy, or a wallet connected directly) for Tempora Labs treasury skills, with a confirmation page before every send. Never holds a key.

plugins.name: connect
plugins.description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — wallet connect plugin for AI agents. Ships the connect skill: sign-in with Google/email or a direct wallet, session status, disconnect, switch, and relaying one prepared call through a confirmation page for a signature. Holds no keys.
